resources.string: Sign in with ChatGPT in your system browser, then enter the one-time code shown here. The code expires in 15 minutes. If prompted, enable device code authorization in ChatGPT security settings. Only authorize a code you requested in this app.
Authorization failed or expired. Check your network/proxy, enable device code authorization in ChatGPT security settings if needed, then retry.
Codex authorization expired or was revoked. Open account settings and reconnect with OAuth.
Codex authorization request failed. Check the network/proxy and try again.
Codex usage request failed (HTTP %1$d). Check your account and network.
